system.description: A vast, contaminated sewer and stormwater undercity beneath Seattle, warped by corporate dumping and lingering Resonance anomalies.
system.impulses: Isolate intruders, Pollute and mutate, Hide crimes and secrets, Rearrange safe routes, Surface danger into the city above

system.description: Pools and runoff trenches contain corrosive biotech waste. When a PC falls prone in contaminated water or remains submerged, they must mark a Stress. *What corp signature, chemical sheen, or impossible color reveals where this runoff came from?* *What has learned to thrive here that should not exist?*

system.description: Residual Resonance carries voices, radio fragments, and memory echoes through the sewer network. A PC who investigates the soundscape can make an Instinct Roll. - **Critical Success:** Learn a valuable clue and a safe or hidden route. - **Success with Hope:** Learn a useful clue, shortcut, or warning. - **Success with Fear:** Learn something true but alarming or incomplete. - **Any Failure:** The echoes become disorienting; mark a Stress to gain one relevant clue. *Whose voice should not still be here?* *What secret does the sewer remember better than the people above it?*

system.description: Ancient automated gates suddenly open or slam shut, changing the layout of the environment. Separate the party, block retreat, reveal a shortcut, or flush a hazard or adversary into the scene. *Which route closes at the worst possible time?* *What forgotten accessway opens that no one expected to still function?*

system.description: Mutated fungal mats burst into green-blue light, coating the chamber in sickly illumination. Hidden creatures are revealed and stealth becomes significantly harder until the light fades. *What shapes or symbols appear in the bloom that suggest Resonance corruption?* *What living thing is suddenly visible that the PCs wish had stayed hidden?*

system.description: When a PC rolls with Fear, blackwater surges through the chamber. All creatures in exposed areas must make an Agility Reaction Roll. - Targets who fail are knocked down and swept to a nearby zone or hazardous position. - Targets who succeed keep their footing but must mark a Stress. *What debris or evidence comes rushing past in the surge?* *What new danger does the flood leave behind when it recedes?*
